summary: Baseline error analysis before changing the model: split statistics (per-feature mean/std shift between train and validation, per-example mean, std and norm), error slices of the baseline's validation predictions (by class or target quantile, input-norm and input-mean quantile, any given group), cheap invariance probes (quick ridge and k-NN refits on train under none, per-example centering, per-example standardization, split-wise standardization and shift-invariant features, plus within-split CV) and ranked hypotheses that tell an additive offset, a gain change, a feature-wise shift, a spatial or positional shift and information loss apart, each with a prediction and a falsifier. Inputs are NPZ arrays x, y, ids. Reads train, validation, optional predictions, groups and task only: no test data. Exploratory; makes no claim.

task_type.description: default: task.task_type, else inferred from the training labels

layout.description: how positions are arranged, for the shift-invariant probe; auto: image for 3-D arrays or a square number (>= 64) of features, else sequence; tabular skips that probe

group_keys.description: extra arrays in the validation NPZ to slice errors by

groups_key.description: array in the groups input (with ids); default groups

prediction_key.description: array in the predictions input; default predictions

min_effect.description: smallest score that counts as support; default 0.02
